content: The execution was successful with a perfect reward (1.0). The strategy of handling HWPX (XML-based zip) by concatenating text nodes within a paragraph (`<hp:p>`) to resolve split placeholders, performing replacements, and then stripping layout cache elements (`<hp:lineSegArray>`) is highly effective. This pattern ensures both content integrity and correct rendering in Hancom Office by forcing the application to recalculate the layout. The specific logic for Korean age calculation (만 나이) and phone number normalization (000-0000-0000) was also correctly implemented.
